Name: Siv's Marriage Mod Name Fix Files
Author: Zygosis
Description:
These are just some fixes to the NPCDisposition files for Siv's marriage mod, this fixes the name bug a few people have been experiencing, just trying to help out since I saw a few people saying they couldn't do the fix themselves since they arent mod savvy been modding for a while now so it was easy to do. Just add extract the zip folder and moves the files to your Stardew Valley\Content\Data file and override and everything should be just right :)PS- I did change the wizard's name to Rasmodius and the dwarfs name to Thorin, happy to change though if need be. Just let me know 

REQUIRES ORIGINAL MOD, linked here:
